name: Heidelberg

queries.query: Heidelberg Germany official cadastral parcel map GIS Flurstücke Liegenschaftskataster
queries.result: First-party Heidelberg and Baden-Württemberg results identified the Heidelberg Vermessungsamt as local custodian, the city Geoportal, and the state Liegenschaftskataster/Geoportal service. The current city Geoportal WMS capabilities expose a queryable Liegenschaftskarte layer, but no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

queries.query: Heidelberg amtliche Liegenschaftskarte Flurstücke Geoportal offiziell
queries.result: Offizielle Ergebnisse bestätigen das Heidelberger Vermessungsamt, die Führung des Liegenschaftskatasters und das Geoportal Heidelberg. Die anonyme Abfrage des aktuellen Layers Liegenschaftskarte lieferte kein Objekt mit sicherer Flurstückskennung und vollständiger Geometrie.

registryEvidence.custodian: Stadt Heidelberg, Vermessungsamt, Abteilung Liegenschaftskataster; state-level ALKIS/Liegenschaftskataster support by Landesamt für Geoinformation und Landentwicklung Baden-Württemberg (LGL)
registryEvidence.scope: The city page states that the Vermessungsamt maintains the Liegenschaftskataster and provides the Heidelberg Geoportal; official service information describes cadastral extracts and parcel/building records.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This establishes a local custodian and a public city map service, not an open downloadable parcel-vector feed or runtime adapter.
registryEvidence.localityNote: The supplied WUP point is preserved exactly; the Geoportal WMS advertised bounding box covers the point's Heidelberg area.

parcelDiscovery.source: Heidelberg Geoportal OSIRIS GCGisService WMS, Liegenschaftskarte layer
parcelDiscovery.boundedResponse: The anonymous GetFeatureInfo response was an empty OSIRIS_Objektmenge with gml:null unavailable; no feature ID or geometry was returned.
parcelDiscovery.note: The service exposes a rendered/queryable cadastral layer, but no safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was verified. No GeoJSON sample retained.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Current JavaScript/configuration loaded; it identifies the public Heidelberg OSIRIS Geoportal, map proxy, and GCGisService routes.
Live OSIRIS WMS capabilities returned. Liegenschaftskarte is queryable; advertised CRS includes EPSG:25832, EPSG:4326, EPSG:31467 and EPSG:3857. The capabilities bbox covers the WUP point area.
Anonymous bounded map request returned a PNG for the Liegenschaftskarte layer; rendered imagery does not provide a safe native ID or full polygon geometry.
Empty OSIRIS object response with gml:null unavailable; no exact-point hit or miss inference was made.
Same empty OSIRIS object response; alternate safe response format did not expose schema, identity or geometry.
Official configured map-proxy route returned the site's maintenance page; no retry bypass or inference was made.
Configured legacy GeoServer path was not present at the public host.
Returned LayerNotDefined for guessed layer name Flurstuecke; this failed probe was not treated as evidence against the verified Liegenschaftskarte layer.
